options.name: data-dir
options.label: Data folder: where the model files go (tens of GB)

options.name: gguf-dir
options.label: Model files you already have
options.hint: (optional) a folder with the model files already downloaded

options.name: vision
options.label: Read pictures too (screenshots, photos, scanned pages; a 0.9 GB download)
choices: On: the reader for this GPU (on the GPU from 24 GB of VRAM, else on the CPU)
On, the reader on the GPU (the CPU when it cannot start there)
On, the reader on the CPU

options.name: kv
options.label: KV cache precision (the model's memory of the conversation)
choices: 4-bit: half the memory, a little less precise on long documents
8-bit keys and 4-bit values: about three quarters of the memory

options.name: rope-scaling
options.label: RoPE extension: a context past the model's trained 262,144 positions rescales its rotary angles
choices: yarn (keeps the trained angles on the high-frequency pairs)

options.name: experimental-speed-projection
options.label: EXPERIMENTAL - speed projection (off unless you choose it)
choices: On, with another control vector (a GGUF file)
options.hint: another control vector, a GGUF file
options.about: A small control vector applied while the model runs (layers 4-44). It changes how the model answers: its package describes it as a refusal-direction projection (the model declines far fewer requests). When on, the web app can switch it off per chat. For fewer refusals, choose SC117's or huihui-ai's abliterated version as the model instead (the refusals removed in its weights).

options.name: web-search
options.label: Web search, for every model: the model searches when a request asks for it (the web page's Search switch, the API's web search tools)
choices: DeepSeek's search API: your API key, billed by DeepSeek per search (USD 0.75 per 1,000); the search words go to DeepSeek
TinyFish's search API: your API key, free up to a daily allowance (12,000 searches, 1,000 pages read); the search words and the pages found go to TinyFish

options.name: deepseek-api-key
options.label: DeepSeek API key (kept in your settings, never shown)
options.needed: Web search with DeepSeek needs your DeepSeek API key.

options.name: tinyfish-api-key
options.label: TinyFish API key (kept in your settings, never shown)
options.needed: Web search with TinyFish needs your TinyFish API key.

options.name: vision-tokens
options.label: The most image tokens a picture becomes (more reads small text better, and takes longer)
options.hint: 1024 on the GPU, 300 on the CPU
options.takes: a number of image tokens, 1 or more

options.name: rope-scale
options.label: RoPE extension factor (1 or more)

options.name: low-ram
options.label: Low-RAM mode: the experts read from the model files instead of all copied into RAM
choices: Auto: when the experts do not fit the RAM
On, the experts the GPU does not hold copied into RAM
On, the experts the GPU does not hold read through the OS file cache

options.name: resident-budget-gib
options.label: GiB of the experts kept in RAM (the rest read from the SSD)

options.name: ram-reserve-gib
options.label: RAM left free for other programs, in GiB (the model's mode, its experts in RAM and the image models' sizes are chosen with that much less; slower when the experts are then read from the SSD)
options.hint: (none) GiB of RAM to leave free for other programs
options.takes: a number of GiB, 0 or more

options.name: parallel
options.label: Requests decoded together (each takes VRAM from the expert cache)
options.takes: a number of requests, 1 or more

options.name: replicas
options.label: With a layer split: independent engines, each on an equal group of the GPUs
options.takes: a number of engines, 1 or more

options.name: source
options.label: Where the model files come from

options.name: models-dir
options.label: Where the model files go

options.name: move-data
options.label: Move the model files already on this PC into the data folder

options.name: set-default-data-dir
options.label: Remember the data folder for later downloads without moving anything

options.name: no-warmup
options.label: Skip the first start that compiles the GPU code (the first request then takes ~30 s more)

options.name: image-lora-training
options.label: Also prepare the bases for LoRA training

options.name: image-gpu
options.label: The GPU that makes the images
choices: Auto: a GPU the text model does not use, else the text model's

options.name: image-sam3-license
options.label: Agree to Meta's SAM License, so that SAM 3.1 finds a part of a picture by words (find_region, edit_region); without it Florence-2 (MIT) finds the parts

options.name: image-dit-q8
options.label: Mage-Flow, MOSS-Image and Anima: the image model on the GPU
choices: Auto: 16-bit when it fits the VRAM with its text encoder, else 8-bit

options.name: image-dit-keep
options.label: Mage-Flow: the image model not in use (the generation's or the edit's)
choices: Keep the one not in use in RAM (quick switch)
Let it go (about 4.4 GB less RAM)

options.name: image-ssd-offload
options.label: Keep the image models' sizes when the RAM is short, reading what does not fit from the SSD (slower)

options.name: image-gpu-policy
options.label: The text model while an image is made
choices: Auto: stays when both fit, else gives VRAM back or is unloaded
Give VRAM back for the image
Unload it, its conversation restored afterwards

options.name: gpu
options.label: GPU
choices: As set up (the one with the most VRAM the first time)

options.name: gpus
options.label: Split the model's layers over these GPUs (two or more; the first runs the early layers)

options.name: layer-split
options.label: With a split: the first layer of each later GPU's share (e.g. 36, or 16,32 for three GPUs)
options.takes: auto or rising layer numbers, e.g. 36 or 16,32

options.name: port
options.label: Port
options.hint: as set up (8095 for a new model)

options.name: host
options.label: Who may connect (with networks: set an API key too)

options.name: api-key
options.label: API key
options.hint: (none) a key the clients must send; several: key1,key2

options.name: vram-reserve-mib
options.label: VRAM left free for other programs, in MiB
options.takes: a number of MiB, 0 or more

options.name: draft-vocab
options.label: The draft layer's tokens
choices: As set up (with Chinese, Japanese and Korean the first time)
English and code only (~110 MiB less VRAM)
English, code and the Cyrillic script

options.name: script-guard
options.label: Other languages' characters in the answers, for every model (the thinking is left as it is)
choices: Japanese: no Simplified Chinese, Hangul or Vietnamese letters in the answers
English and others: no CJK characters or Vietnamese letters
Korean: no kana, Han characters Korean does not use, or Vietnamese letters
Chinese (Simplified): no kana, Hangul or Japanese-only characters
Chinese (Traditional): no kana, Hangul or Japanese-only characters
Off: answers as the model writes them

options.name: ple-io
options.label: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's n-gram table
choices: As set up (auto: chosen by the RAM and the disk)
Auto: chosen by the RAM and the disk
The whole table in RAM (faster new prompts, ~29 GB more RAM)
Read from the SSD as needed

options.name: old-driver
options.label: Start although the Intel GPU's driver is older than the one setup asks for
